# Subway Seat for Alacritty

Normal, bright and dim colors, both cursors, selection, search, hints, footer bar and line indicator. If your alacritty.toml already has a `[general]` table, add the `import` line to it; a second `[general]` is a TOML error. Alacritty doesn't follow the system light/dark setting, so pick one flavor.

[Alacritty](https://alacritty.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/alacritty/) · Needs Alacritty 0.14+

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only alacritty
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/alacritty/alacritty.toml:

```toml
[general]
import = ["~/.config/alacritty/themes/subway-seat.toml"]
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/alacritty/alacritty.toml:

```toml
[general]
import = ["~/.config/alacritty/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml"]
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/alacritty/alacritty.toml:

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/alacritty/themes/subway-seat.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/alacritty/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/alacritty/themes/subway-seat-enamel.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/alacritty/themes/london-moquette.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/alacritty/themes/london-deep-level.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/alacritty/themes/london-portland.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/alacritty/themes/paris-guimard.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/alacritty/themes/paris-catacombes.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/alacritty/themes/paris-carrelage.toml`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
